title: Title & Registration Services Lien Notation Correction Charge
content:
A lien notation correction charge is added to the lien charges on a Title & Registration Services order returned for a lien information error: eight dollars (8.00) when a lien recording fee was already collected on the order, because a recorded notation has to be corrected; four dollars (4.00) when no lien recording fee was collected and the order records a lienholder, because the notation is added late; and nothing when the order records no lienholder.

"Already collected" refers to the state fee entries collected on the title order under the lien recording fee before the lien charges are collected. The lienholder is the one recorded on the title order.

| Lien recording fee entry already on the order | Lienholder recorded on the order | Lien notation correction charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 8.00 |
| no | yes | 4.00 |
| no | none | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An order that collected a lien recording fee at opening: 8.00.
- An order recording a lienholder whose lien recording fee was never collected: 4.00.
